_about: Public-domain Cleland Boyd McAfee (1866-1944), Presbyterian pastor, McCormick Seminary professor and hymn writer, for the Word Hoard: Where He Is, The Growing Church, The Worth of a Man, The Mosaic Law in Modern Life, Studies in the Sermon on the Mount, The Greatest English Classic, His Peace, The Old and the New in Theology, The Westminster Confession and the Present Task of the Church, Psalms of the Social Life, The Christian Faith and the New Day, The Christian Conviction, Changing Foreign Missions, Ministerial Practices, and The Christian Message and Program. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 99 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
